"""Check all V163 masks against V162's already independent pixel oracle."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);previous=Path(plan['previous'])
status=read(root/'status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review' and not live(status['owner'])
oracle_binding=ref(previous/'training-mask-audit-v1.json');oracle=read(oracle_binding['path'])
assert oracle['mask_arrays_checked']==1000
prior=read(previous/'plan-v1.json');assert plan['cache']==prior['cache']
assert ref(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/flat_target_anchor.py')['sha256']==ref(Path(prior['work'])/'scripts/flat_target_anchor.py')['sha256']
before=read(previous/'train-result-v1.json')['trace'];after=read(root/'train-result-v1.json')['trace']
assert len(before)==len(after)==1000
rows=[]
for old,new in zip(before,after,strict=True):
    assert all(old[k]==new[k] for k in ['step','batch','domain','flat_target_mask'])
    rows.append({'step':new['step'],'batch':new['batch'],'domain':new['domain'],'flat_target_mask':new['flat_target_mask']})
output=root/'training-mask-replay-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass-all1000-exact-masks-against-inherited-independent-oracle',
    'training':ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),'baseline_training':ref(previous/'train-result-v1.json'),
    'independent_V162_oracle':oracle_binding,'same_cache':plan['cache'],'unchanged_mask_source':ref(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/flat_target_anchor.py'),
    'matched_mask_records':1000,'rows':rows,'new_independent_mask_computations':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Exact target batch bindings,unchanged mask source and all1000 actual mask fingerprints/counts replay V162,whose masks were independently computed from original cached target pixels. This is inherited oracle verification,not a new independent mask computation. No inference-flatness or unseen-image guarantee.'})
print('PASS all1000 actual V163 masks match independently audited V162 masks on identical cache/source')
